title: Playboy Magazine December 1971 Gala Christmas Nabokov Polanski Connery
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; cover wear, scuffs, creases and edge/corner wear consistent with a magazine of this age. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, December 1971 - Gala Christmas Issue. Cover price $1.50.
The classic Rabbit Head cover with the dove.

Features:
- A wry entertainment by Vladimir Nabokov
- Bruce Jay Friedman on Sex in Fun City
- An Arthur C. Clarke novelette
- Playboy Interviews Roman Polanski
- Movie Sex Stars of 1971
- A startling look at Howard Hughes
- Sean Connery returns as James Bond
- Top photographers' most erotic pictures
- Plus Herbert Gold, Allan Sherman, Richard "M*A*S*H" Hooker, Calvin Trillin, Dan Greenburg and Alan Harrington
